services.name: Essential Exterior
services.description: Careful, paint-safe exterior care. Not paint correction, paint protection film, or a ceramic coating.
inclusions: Two-bucket contact wash with separate wheel tools
Water spotting check on glass, mirrors and badges
services.exclusions: Not paint correction, paint protection film, or a ceramic coating.

services.name: Fabric Freshness
services.description: Care for the cabin, fabrics, mats and touchpoints. Specialty stain and odor work is agreed separately.
inclusions: Interior vacuum, including mats and trunk
Fabric and mat care appropriate to the material
services.exclusions: Specialty stain and odor work is agreed separately in your Care Plan.

services.name: Total Therapy
services.description: The approved exterior and interior services together, with one agreed scope.
inclusions: One coordinated visit with a single agreed scope
services.exclusions: Specialty work beyond the two approved services is agreed separately in your Care Plan.

services.name: Cured Ceramic Coating
services.description: An open conversation about cured ceramic coating. Priced case-by-case in your Care Plan after a personal review.
inclusions: A personal conversation about your goals and the current finish
A case-by-case scope and price in your Care Plan
services.exclusions: No upfront total is calculated here. Scope, prep and price are set individually in your Care Plan.

availability.note: We confirm the exact visit window with you before the date.

labels.reply: You will hear from us personally, usually within a day.
labels.honesty: If we are not the right fit for the car or the job, we will say so plainly.
labels.price: Final scope and price are confirmed after we review the car.

travelPolicy: Any travel surcharge is confirmed with you before work begins. Parking fees for non-private residential or office locations are billed at cost.
